// diagnostic

L2510

{operation} repeats inside a loop.

What

{operation} repeats inside a loop.

Why

A repeated copy or representation fallback can make a growing value's cost super-linear.

Fix

Insert `{fix}` before the highlighted expression to make the copy explicit.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L2510: tests/ui_lint/cost_hidden_in_loop.warn.

Warning [L2510] (hidden_cost_in_loop): This copy of `String (text)` view into an owned slot repeats inside a loop.
  --> tests/ui_lint/cost_hidden_in_loop.jet:12:33
    |
 12 |     loop _ in 0..<3 -> out.push(view)
    |                                 ^^^^
 Why: A repeated copy or representation fallback can make a growing value's cost super-linear.
 Fix: Bind the copy once outside the loop, or keep views with `[View<str>]`
